### ★★★ Self-Enumeration for Phase II of Census 2027 Commences in Goa, Punjab, Uttar Pradesh and Non-Snow-Bound Areas of Uttarakhand

*16 Nov · Ministry of Home Affairs · [PIB](https://pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2337054) · [Jagran Josh](https://news.google.?oc=5)*

- Corresponding house-to-house Population Enumeration in these States and areas will be conducted from December 1, 2026 to January 4, 2027 followed by a revisional round from January 5 to 9, 2027
- To participate in Self-Enumeration during Phase II, residents can log in to official portal se.census.gov.in using their mobile number (preferably the one registered during Phase I)
- While Self-Enumeration allows residents to provide their details online at their convenience, Enumerators will continue to carry out door-to-door visits in all allocated blocks

**Exam angle:** Note the scheme's name, the ministry or department running it, launch date, outlay and who benefits. Links to “Demographics & human development”. Useful as a Punjab example in Mains.

**Syllabus:** [Demographics & human development](../syllabus/PRE1/59-pbg3-demographics-human-development.md) · [Population & migration](../syllabus/PRE1/48-p1g1-population-migration.md) · [Statistical analysis, graphs & diagrams](../syllabus/GS3/09-g3st1-statistical-analysis-graphs-diagrams.md)
